intro: We do not publish package prices, because a deck over an existing slab and a deck on new footings down a hillside are not the same job, and pretending otherwise is how people end up with change orders. What we do instead is give you a free written scope and number before anything starts — what is included, what is not, and what would change it. If a material choice moves the price, you hear about it while you can still decide, not on the final invoice.
notes: Free consultations and written estimates on every project. Serving Nanticoke, Wilkes-Barre, Hunlock Creek, Dallas, Kingston, Mountain Top and the surrounding Wyoming Valley.
